Hi Avery (and Hannah),

Thanks again for the intro — our payments platform team in Milan and a small office in Singapore want a quick product walkthrough to validate latency/cost numbers and ask a few infra/security questions. We need about 35–40 minutes including Q&A.

Two windows that look workable for us next week (local times):
- Wednesday 29 Oct, 15:00–15:40 CET (that should be 22:00–22:40 SGT)
- Thursday 30 Oct, 09:00–09:40 CET (16:00–16:40 SGT)

Note: our APAC engineering lead (Priya) prefers the earlier SGT slot if possible — she’s on the road the week after. We realize the EU clocks switch at the end of October, which may be messy; just flagging so we can lock a time that works across teams.

Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood prefers an EU-friendly or APAC-friendly window? If neither works, give 2 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

We're generally happy to meet in whichever window gives you the broadest attendance. Two internal constraints on our side:
- Marissa (our Solutions lead) is traveling to Berlin from 28–30 Oct and has a block of meetings midday on the 29th.
- I have a later commitment on 29th evening PST that would make a 22:00 SGT slot tough for me.

Given that, the Thu 30 Oct 09:00 CET / 16:00 SGT slot is cleaner for our group. If Priya absolutely needs the earlier SGT time, we can flip and Marissa will dial in from a transit window, but wanted to surface the trade-offs.

Proposed final: Thu 30 Oct, 09:00–09:40 CET (16:00–16:40 SGT). I'll hold that tentatively and send a calendar invite once you confirm. Agenda: 20 min walkthrough, 15 min Q&A + next steps.

Avery
